context: Two cafe friends gossip about mutual acquaintances
purpose: Teach: もっぱら/それなのに/いやぁ/おもっ/しょっちゅう/時折/一口/出番

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ねぇ聞いてよ、最近うちの店、健ちゃんがしょっちゅう来るの。
lines.en: Hey listen, lately Ken-chan comes to our shop all the time.
lines.style: Gossipy whisper leaning over the counter, eyes lit up.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えー、あの人?もっぱらの噂だと、彼女ができたらしいよ。
lines.en: Eh, that guy? Rumor has it he got a girlfriend.
lines.style: Eyes wide, dropping voice with delighted scandal energy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: それなのに、時折ひとりで来てケーキを一口だけ食べて帰るの。
lines.en: And yet, occasionally he comes alone, takes one bite of cake, and leaves.
lines.style: Frowning suspiciously, miming a tiny bite with her fingers.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いやぁ、それ絶対なんかあるじゃん。喧嘩中とかかなって、ずっとおもってたんだよね。
lines.en: Whoa, something's definitely up with that. I've been thinking maybe they're fighting.
lines.style: Leaning in conspiratorially, hands cupped around her latte.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: でしょ?この前なんて、別の女の人と一緒に入ってきて、私の出番来た!って思って観察したの。
lines.en: Right? The other day he came in with a different woman, and I was like, my turn has come, and watched closely.
lines.style: Grinning like a detective, tapping her temple knowingly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: アオイ、完全に探偵気取りじゃん。で、その人どんな感じだったの?
lines.en: Aoi, you're totally playing detective. So what was she like?
lines.style: Laughing softly but desperate for every detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: それがさ、めちゃくちゃ綺麗な人で、健ちゃんすごく紳士的にエスコートしてて、ちょっとびっくりした。
lines.en: So get this, she was super pretty, and Ken-chan was being really gentlemanly escorting her, kinda surprised me.
lines.style: Eyebrows raised dramatically, miming opening a door for someone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うわぁ、それもう浮気確定でしょ。次来たら絶対LINE頂戴、私も陰から見たい。
lines.en: Ugh, that's basically confirmed cheating. Text me next time he comes, I wanna spy too.
lines.style: Slapping the table once, scandalized but utterly thrilled.
